scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Claire Sullivan and I'm 69. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello Claire, I can certainly help you look into that charge. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of the card that was charged?
Sure, my account number is 8849201 and the card ends in 4492.
Thank you. Just to confirm, could you also verify your full billing address and the date of birth associated with the account?
My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and my date of birth is May 12, 1955.
Thanks for that. I see the transaction here for $76 at 'Global Retail Services'. Does that name ring a bell at all, or should I go ahead and pull up the merchant details?
No, that name doesn't mean anything to me. I'm certain I didn't shop there.

I see. Per our standard terms, I've checked the transaction logs and since this merchant is flagged as a third-party aggregator, I'm going to go ahead and open a formal dispute for you. This will initiate a temporary credit while we investigate.
Oh, that sounds like a lot of work. Is there anything else I need to do?
Not at this time. I have submitted the dispute case, number 99283-A. You should see the credit reflect in your balance within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

resolution_summary: Agent verified account details, confirmed the transaction was unrecognized, and initiated a formal dispute and temporary credit for the $76 charge.

judge_scores.justification: The agent verified the customer's identity with appropriate rigor and efficiently investigated the unrecognized transaction without redundant questions. Furthermore, the agent correctly cited standard terms to open a formal dispute and issued a temporary credit, resolving the issue directly and professionally.
